SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S. B. REGISTER / 5926）
Date ____ June 8, 1934

Subject (in full) ____ Circular Order No. 793, issued by Judge Feng at the
request of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.

Made by ____ D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa ____ Forwarded by ____ 〔此处转录不清〕

Regarding Circular Order No. 793, dated June 6, 1934,
issued for the arrest of one Tsu Soong Zeu (朱松寿), age about 40,
native of Kiangying, who is wanted by the Shanghai Public Safety
Bureau for communist activities, I have to report that in
addition to notifying the Chinese detectives and agents attached
to this section, particulars of this individual have been recorded
for future reference.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

〔此处转录不清〕

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.2，特别分部
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 特别分部登记簿 / 5926）
日期 ____ 1934年6月8日

事由（全称）____ 冯法官应上海市公安局请求发布的第793号通缉令。

制作人 ____ 督察顾保华 ____ 转呈人 ____ 〔此处转录不清〕

关于1934年6月6日发布的第793号通缉令，该令要求逮捕朱松寿（Tsu Soong Zeu），年龄约40岁，江苏江阴人，因从事共产主义活动被上海市公安局通缉。兹报告如下：除通知本分部所属华籍侦探及密探外，已将该人的详细情况记录在案，以备日后查考。

顾保华
督察

特别分部主管警官。

〔此处转录不清〕
